html:
Interior Design Services

Creating Spaces That Inspire and Function

Our interior design service runs the full distance: brief, concept, drawings, material selection, procurement and installation. We take on residential, commercial and luxury projects, and we stay involved right through execution - because a design is ultimately only as good as the joinery that finally gets built.

Our Comprehensive Interior Design Services

"We offer a wide range of services that cover every aspect of interior design, ensuring a seamless experience from concept to completion."

1. Residential Interior Design

From modern apartments to lavish villas, we craft living spaces that are comfortable, stylish, and functional. We focus on personalized layouts, color palettes, lighting solutions, and décor that bring your vision to life.

2. Commercial Interior Design

We create offices, showrooms, retail spaces, and hospitality interiors that enhance productivity, impress clients, and reflect your brand identity. Efficient space planning and aesthetic appeal are at the core of our designs.

3. Luxury & Premium Interiors

For high-end clients, we provide bespoke interior solutions that combine elegance, innovation, and exclusivity. Our designs feature premium materials, custom furnishings, and advanced lighting and décor solutions.

4. Space Planning & 3D Visualization

We provide detailed space planning, 3D renderings, and virtual walkthroughs to help clients visualize their interiors before execution. This ensures precision, minimizes errors, and creates a clear design roadmap.

What Our Interior Design Services Include

Most people come to us with a feeling rather than a brief: the flat feels cramped, the office no longer suits the team, the new villa is a shell that needs a personality. Our interior design services turn that feeling into a plan you can build. Over 22 years and more than 800 completed spaces, we have learned that the order of decisions matters as much as the decisions themselves, so every project follows the same disciplined sequence.

1. Brief and site study

We start by measuring the space and listening. Who uses each room, at what time of day, and for what? Where does the light come from, and where does storage keep running out? The answers become a written brief that the whole team designs against.

2. Concept and space planning

Layouts come before finishes. We test furniture positions, circulation routes and door swings on plan, then present a concept with mood boards so you can see the direction before any money is committed.

3. 3D visualisation

Photorealistic 3D views and walkthroughs let you stand inside the design before it exists. This is where most changes happen, and changing a drawing costs far less than changing a wall.

4. Working drawings and material selection

Once the design is approved, we prepare detailed drawings for joinery, false ceilings, electrical points, lighting and flooring, and finalise every material and finish with you.

5. Procurement, execution and handover

Our project managers coordinate vendors, site teams and quality checks against structured milestones. We stay on site through installation and hand over a finished space, backed by our 10-year warranty and fixed timelines.

Interior Design Services for Homes

For apartments, independent houses and villas, our interior design services cover living and dining areas, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, home offices and storage. We plan wardrobes and modular kitchens around how you actually cook and dress, choose lighting in layers, and keep the palette coherent from room to room. Homeowners who want a deeper look at this work can read about our residential interior design and luxury home interior design services.

Interior Design Services for Businesses

Commercial projects carry different pressures: a fixed opening date, a brand to express and staff who need to work efficiently from day one. We design offices, showrooms, salons and hospitality spaces with those constraints in mind, from reception to back-of-house. See how we approach office interiors and showroom design in more detail.

How We Keep Projects on Budget

Budget overruns usually come from late decisions. Because drawings, materials and quantities are fixed before work starts, our pricing is transparent and milestone-based, with no hidden costs added halfway through. If the budget needs to come down, we show you where a change saves money without weakening the design, rather than quietly swapping in cheaper materials.

Questions Worth Asking Any Designer

  • Will I see the design in 3D before work starts on site?
  • Is the quote broken into milestones, and what exactly does each one cover?
  • Who supervises the site day to day, and how often will I get updates?
  • What warranty applies to the finished work, and for how long?

Clear answers to these questions are a good sign that a firm will deliver what it draws.

Where We Work

Our head office is in Pitampura, Delhi, with a branch in Gurgaon. We deliver interior design services across Delhi NCR, including Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Chhattarpur, Hauz Khas, Rajokri and Pitampura, as well as Karnal. Our service areas page lists each location.

Start With a Conversation

Every good project begins with a clear brief. Book a free consultation and our senior designers will walk through your space, your budget and your timeline, then recommend which of our interior design services fits the job best. You can also browse our completed projects to see the standard of finish we deliver.

Why Choose Our Interior Design Services

  • Expert Designers
  • Tailored Solutions
  • Attention to Detail
  • End-to-End Support

Our mission is to create spaces that are beautiful, functional, and uniquely yours. With our interior design services, your home, office, or commercial space will not only look stunning but also provide comfort, efficiency, and lasting value.

Frequently Asked Questions

What interior design services does 9th Corner offer?

Space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material and furniture selection, custom furniture, lighting design and site supervision, for homes, offices, salons, showrooms and hospitality spaces.

Do you handle both design and execution?

Yes. We stay involved from the first brief to installation. You can also choose design and drawings only and use your own contractor.

How does a project start?

It starts with a meeting and a site visit to understand your needs, space and budget. We then share a proposal, followed by layouts, 3D views and drawings for your approval.

How are interior design services priced?

Fees depend on the size of the space, the type of project and the scope of work. We share a clear proposal after the first meeting so you know what is included.

Which cities do you work in?

We work across Delhi NCR, including Delhi, Gurgaon and Noida, and also take projects in Karnal.
